reason: The cited lines define a read-only browser snapshot tool that captures and returns/saves an accessibility snapshot of the current page. They do not show arbitrary host code execution. They do not show sending agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination; saving to a workspace-relative file is not enough to establish a SINK. The snapshot may contain non-public data depending on what the current page is, but these lines alone do not establish access to credentials, local files, intranet, or other secrets. The returned page snapshot is browser page content, which can be attacker-controlled, so UNTRUSTED is supported.
